items.description: The agent that grows with you

Open-source AI job search agent and job finder: scan job boards, score each job 1-5 against your CV before you apply, tailor an ATS-friendly resume and cover letter, get interview prep and an application tracker. It helps you fill in each application; you press Submit. Runs locally in Codex, OpenCode and other AI CLIs, or as a Claude Code plugin.
Scale computer-use 2.0 with open-source drivers, cross-OS sandboxes, and benchmarks for training, evaluation, and data generation.
An open-source AI coding agent that lives in your terminal.
AI Agents & MCPs & AI Workflow Automation • (~400 MCP servers for AI agents) • AI Automation / AI Agent with MCPs • AI Workflows & AI Agents • MCPs for AI Agents

Omnigent is an open-source AI agent framework and meta-harness: orchestrate Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, and custom agents — swap harnesses without rewriting, enforce policies and sandboxing, and collaborate in real time from any device.

Open-source desktop SQL workspace with 3 built-in database drivers and 26 shipped driver plugins, including SQL Server, DuckDB, ClickHouse and Redis. Built-in MCP server for Claude, Cursor and Devin, SQL notebooks and visual EXPLAIN.
A persistent workspace for development work that self-improves and continues beyond one session.

Natively — Free open-source AI meeting assistant, interview copilot, and note taker. The best alternative to Cluely, Otter, Granola, Final Round AI, Fireflies, and Interview Coder. Real-time transcription, AI meeting notes, lecture recording, local RAG, BYOK, and stealth mode. Runs locally. No subscriptions. No data breaches.
Adaptive Test-time Learning and Autonomous Specialization
Open-source AI browser agent for Chrome and Firefox (monorepo) 🧠
Okou connects to the tools your team already uses and does the work — across marketing, sales, engineering, and operations, under your control.

Open-source GrokBot alternative built on DeepSeek Harness. Build your personal bot team: multiple personal agents with persistent memory, identities and permissions, extensible through DSH plugins.｜基于 DeepSeek Harness 的开源 GrokBot 平替：有长期记忆的个人 AI Bot 团队，支持多 Bot 协作、身份权限与插件生态扩展。MIT.
